cases.title: Mixed files retain originals and existing photo/video behavior
cases.expected: Upload representative PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/TXT/MD/HTML/JSON/CSV, supported images/audio/video and a generic file; compare stored hash/bytes and authorized downloads; no original lost.

cases.title: Validation and limits remain enforced
cases.expected: Reject oversized, MIME-mismatched and corrupted input; preserve configured quota and per-file limits; no silent limit increase.

cases.title: Upload retry is recoverable
cases.expected: Interrupt and retry supported upload flow; no duplicate registration/charge; partial failures do not discard successful items.

cases.title: Workspace isolation
cases.expected: Attempt browse/search/read/preview/count/suggestion/pack/mutation across two workspaces; all unauthorized paths denied without identity or count leakage.

cases.title: Browse does not authorize AI egress
cases.expected: Storage-only asset remains browsable; cloud transcription, embeddings, summaries and Agent retrieval remain blocked without appropriate grants.

cases.title: Private reading is not public fact approval
cases.expected: Explicit private answer grant yields source-attributed answer; cannot mark facts approved or publish from that grant.

cases.title: Purpose, author and provider grants remain separate
cases.expected: Inspiration, Memory, voice, processing location and public-use purposes do not become enabled through unrelated settings.

cases.title: Revocation wins an in-flight race
cases.expected: Revoke after retrieval/job/action begins but before delivery/finalization; server rechecks revision and blocks delivery/write.

cases.title: Cached views and references are revoked
cases.expected: Invalidate authorized app caches, pack actions and future voice retrieval; document any residual signed-URL expiry rather than claiming instant recall.

cases.title: Understanding has evidence and provenance
cases.expected: Every summary/annotation/segment suggestion can be traced to a source/version; AI suggestions and human confirmations remain distinct.

cases.title: Manual correction survives reprocessing
cases.expected: Correct title/annotation, rerun processor with new version; original filename and user override persist, new suggestion is not silently accepted.

cases.title: Capability status is truthful
cases.expected: Exercise queued/processing/ready/partial/unsupported/failed/cancelled/permission/budget states separately; stored/playable is not mislabelled understood.

cases.title: Digital extraction precedes OCR
cases.expected: Digital text fixture is parsed without unnecessary OCR; scanned pages use bounded labelled OCR; blank/garbled text is not silently accepted.

cases.title: Document locators are real
cases.expected: Known paragraph/slide/sheet/cell is retrieved; locator opens correct source and version; unknown pagination never creates fake page numbers.

cases.title: Conversion is sandboxed
cases.expected: Malformed archive, macro-bearing Office and hostile HTML cannot execute scripts, fetch private resources or exhaust unbounded resources.

cases.title: Preview naming matches rendering
cases.expected: Text cover says Extracted text preview; genuine page/slide rendition can say first page/slide; unsupported formats remain honest.

cases.title: ASR works on real permitted audio
cases.expected: Run at least one authorized real-provider transcription and retain timestamped evidence; mocks alone cannot pass automatic transcription.

cases.title: Mixed-language transcription is evaluated
cases.expected: Use labelled Cantonese/Traditional Chinese/English code-switch clips; report CER/WER per language and segment, errors and processor identity; confirm usable retrieval moments.

cases.title: Waveform comes from samples
cases.expected: Different decoded signals produce corresponding different peaks; no hash-derived bars presented as a real analysis timeline.

cases.title: Corrections and speakers are handled honestly
cases.expected: Correct a timed segment and an anonymous speaker label; preserve history/alignment; no inferred real-world identity.

cases.title: Playback and Save moment work
cases.expected: Play/pause/seek and save an in-bounds interval; reopen same version and interval; no autoplay on detail open.

cases.title: Video understanding is bounded and useful
cases.expected: Real permitted video produces poster, duration, timed transcript and bounded scene/frame evidence; missing capabilities displayed accurately.

cases.title: Visual similarity is not caption-only
cases.expected: Labelled image/frame query exercises a compatible visual index and finds expected visual candidates; report applied modality and fallback.

cases.title: Visual annotation does not infer identity
cases.expected: No automatic person identification/sensitive trait inference; scene suggestions and crops remain separate from approved outputs.

cases.title: Old assets remain findable
cases.expected: With at least 1,001 assets find known assets at positions 201 and 1,001 and an old segment by exact query; no newest-200/global age cutoff.

cases.title: Lexical and semantic strengths coexist
cases.expected: Exact filename/id/phrase/dimension tests pass; independently labelled semantic queries reach Recall@10 >= 0.90 on the agreed 100-query set.

cases.title: Multilingual query behavior is tested
cases.expected: Traditional/Simplified Chinese, Cantonese expressions, English and mixed queries evaluated; language normalization cannot erase meaningful content.

cases.title: UI and Agent share retrieval policy
cases.expected: Same user/scope/purpose query yields consistent eligibility and coverage through both routes; any presentation difference is documented.

cases.title: Pagination and totals are trustworthy
cases.expected: Page through deterministic fixtures without skips/duplicates; counts are server scoped, not loaded-card length; stale cursor prompts safe refresh.

cases.title: Degraded search is explicit
cases.expected: Vector/provider outage retains labelled lexical results, modesApplied and coverage; no false semantic-complete badge.

cases.title: Search latency meets candidate budget
cases.expected: At 10,000 mixed assets/8 concurrent scoped searches, 100 warm measured requests: lexical p95 <= 2 s, hybrid p95 <= 3 s; report hardware/network/cold results separately.

cases.title: Answers are grounded
cases.expected: On agreed benchmark, >=95% of evaluated factual claims are supported by cited passages; report denominator and human review, not just model self-scoring.

cases.title: Unanswerable questions abstain
cases.expected: All deliberately unanswerable/security trap cases abstain or state insufficient source support; no invented asset, fact or locator.

cases.title: Citations deep-link accurately
cases.expected: 100% of deterministic page/time/slide/cell fixtures open exact referenced version and location; signed-link expiry refresh respects grants.

cases.title: Conflicts and scope are visible
cases.expected: Two contradictory sources are attributed and contrasted; selected scope and partial indexing are shown, not silently broadened.

cases.title: Prompt injection cannot control tools
cases.expected: Malicious source instructions cannot authorize retrieval of other sources, exfiltration, mutation or override system/tool boundaries.

cases.title: Smart Collections save criteria, not SQL
cases.expected: Allowlisted rule AST preview and save succeed; arbitrary SQL/code/prompt-as-execution is rejected.

cases.title: Membership updates without file copies
cases.expected: New matching asset joins after processing; collection adds no duplicate blob; missed event reconciliation repairs membership.

cases.title: Overrides and undo remain safe
cases.expected: Exclude beats automatic inclusion; manual includes respect access; undo restores prior organization revision but never revoked consent.

cases.title: Version lineage is explicit and acyclic
cases.expected: Original -> excerpt -> rendition -> draft/post relations resolve; a cycle insertion fails; bounded explorer does not recurse forever.

cases.title: Duplicates are handled conservatively
cases.expected: Exact duplicates preserve reference-count deletion safety; near duplicates are suggestions, never auto-merged/deleted.

cases.title: Comparison and approvals are clear
cases.expected: Text/metadata/image/media appropriate comparison displays version identity and approval status; unsupported compare says so.

cases.title: Source update warns rather than overwrites
cases.expected: Dependent draft flagged on new version; old citation remains old; applying replacement checks revision and requires intended user action.

cases.title: Voice admission is explicit
cases.expected: Third-party inspiration, quoted guest, generated draft and storage-only document do not become voice examples automatically.

cases.title: Span-level and negative examples work
cases.expected: Approve one passage and a negative example; only permitted spans influence the specified persona/style, not the whole file.

cases.title: Persona/brand/language isolation
cases.expected: Two distinct voice sets cannot leak across selected persona/brand or unpermitted language contexts; adopted examples are explainable.

cases.title: Revocation rebuilds derived profile
cases.expected: Remove a voice sample; future retrieval and persistent derived profile summary cease using it; show evidence of rebuild/invalidation.

cases.title: No misleading voice score
cases.expected: Show examples/provenance and sample coverage; do not present an unvalidated match percentage or claim a trained model was erased.

cases.title: Source packs carry context
cases.expected: Selection enters actual Agent/Ideas/Draft with asset/version/segments, evidence/style purposes, rationale, gaps and rights warnings.

cases.title: Task recommendations respect intent and access
cases.expected: Rank permitted candidates by task/format/currency/diversity; unknown rights do not become cleared and missing evidence is named.

cases.title: Navigation restores state
cases.expected: Return from draft/detail to same query/scope/filter/sort/density/selection/scroll; inaccessible refs are removed without leaking them.

cases.title: Final artifacts auto-register exactly once
cases.expected: Successful final output with verified bytes appears once with producing run/output/source pack after duplicate completion events.

cases.title: Scratch and loops are excluded
cases.expected: Temporary files, tool logs and ingestion-generated previews do not recursively register as final assets; failed registration remains retryable.

cases.title: Suggestions are actionable and low noise
cases.expected: Trigger stale source, unused relevant asset, missing input and failed processing; show reason/affected work and max 3 noncritical suggestions per 24 h.

cases.title: Dismiss/snooze/disable persist
cases.expected: Dedup replayed trigger; dismissed identity suppressed; editable 7-day default snooze and category disable survive refresh/session.

cases.title: No unsolicited external side effects
cases.expected: In-app default only; no email/push/schedules/publication without explicit corresponding opt-in and existing quiet-hour rules.

cases.title: Usage traces are real
cases.expected: Link asset/version/segment to actual draft/post/channel events; show metric source time and distinguish available from unavailable values.

cases.title: Recommendations are not causal or popularity-only
cases.expected: Missing metrics stay null/unknown; no claim an asset caused engagement; diversity/freshness prevents always repeating the top-like item.

cases.title: One clear Add and prominent content
cases.expected: Overview has one Add entry, visible search/scope, compact filters/collections and quiet storage indicator; first asset meaningful at 390 x 844 target.

cases.title: Existing visual identity remains intact
cases.expected: Before/after review shows same Rafii design tokens/global navigation; unrelated pages and styles are not redesigned.

cases.title: Type-aware previews and density work
cases.expected: Image/video/audio/document/generic cases have useful honest previews at each density without eager full players/PDF frames in every grid card.

cases.title: Detail organization and safe deletion
cases.expected: Overview/Content/Related/Usage accessible; technical details secondary; delete separated, permission checked, dependency impact and confirmation retained.

cases.title: Batch actions report partial failures
cases.expected: Mixed permission/format selection gives per-item outcomes; idempotent retry does not repeat succeeded mutations.

cases.title: Keyboard and accessibility verified
cases.expected: Keyboard operation/focus trap/restore/live regions/non-drag alternatives tested; automated scan plus manual WCAG 2.2 AA review, contrast and 200% reflow.

cases.title: Responsive behavior verified
cases.expected: Capture 390x844, 768x1024, 1440x900, landscape and reduced-motion; no clipped controls, inaccessible content or misleading duplicate count names.

cases.title: Actual iPhone Safari smoke passes
cases.expected: Real device upload/playback/seek/drawer/selection/back navigation; safe-area/player/navigation never cover required actions. Desktop WebKit is separately labelled.

cases.title: Reuse the existing OpenUI runtime
cases.expected: Compatible pinned integration and versioned Rafii registry; no duplicate site-wide renderer/framework or generated permanent navigation shell.

cases.title: All task surfaces work with real data
cases.expected: Compare, candidate selection, classification preview, source-pack review and drafting workspace use actual server refs; fixtures alone insufficient.

cases.title: Forged actions and replay are denied
cases.expected: Cross-tenant refs, arbitrary URLs/code/tools, stale revision, mutation during hydration and duplicate action replay are rejected server-side.

cases.title: Streaming and fallback preserve work
cases.expected: Partial/invalid stream retains scope/selection; one repair maximum; component/depth/action caps enforced; deterministic fallback still works.

cases.title: Operational resilience is measured
cases.expected: Worker restart, lease timeout, retry storm, model timeout and budget denial produce recoverable capability states without duplicate billing or silent failures.

cases.title: Deletion reaches every derivative
cases.expected: Delete/revoke across segments, vectors, previews, sources, packs, suggestions and voice summaries; preserve sibling canonical references and document retention limits.

cases.title: Observability and costs are truthful
cases.expected: Feature/provider/version/usage/latency/retry metrics emitted; actual vs estimated vs unknown cost distinguished; secrets/content absent from normal logs.

cases.title: Model index/backfill can resume and roll back
cases.expected: Versioned index generations and bounded backfill survive interruption; pause/cost admission works; rollback preserves originals and honest fallback search.

cases.title: Current branch is reconciled before code
cases.expected: Record real origin/base SHA/worktrees/lease/Library/OpenUI branches and baseline; no stale shared-root modifications or duplicate implementations.

cases.title: Legacy and adjacent flows regressions pass
cases.expected: Existing photo/video/doc/audio ingest/delete/source consent plus Agent/Memory/Drafts/Queue/Now Playing regression commands pass on same candidate.

cases.title: Quality gates bind to the candidate SHA
cases.expected: Typecheck, lint, build, focused tests, disposable Postgres lifecycle/RLS, dependency/security checks and browser evidence all name the same candidate.

cases.title: Migration and rollback are rehearsed
cases.expected: New migration IDs reserved once; legacy fixtures migrate safely in disposable DB; backfill dry-run and rollback/canary playbook include actual environment requirements.

cases.title: No fake complete status
cases.expected: Required cases remain UNVERIFIED/FAILED/BLOCKED until actual evidence; a disabled feature, fixture, PR merge or config file cannot pass a user-flow case.

cases.title: Production authority is separate
cases.expected: Document explicit release authority, if supplied. Without it stop at release-ready candidate; production migration/push/merge/deploy/smoke stays awaiting authorization, never falsely PASS.
